stage: Small action-value prediction feasibility check after attribution; no portfolio promotion
source: CURRENT Strategy 30 only; Strategy 32 is an identical path and not extra evidence
train_admission: Both the fixed-horizon outcome and the original defense episode must have ended strictly before the prediction decision date
decision: Use HALF_REENTRY if predicted incremental return net of defined transaction costs exceeds zero, otherwise FOLLOW_BASE
control: FOLLOW_BASE (zero incremental return); unconditional HALF_REENTRY; expanding training mean with the same sample weights and decision threshold
evaluation: Prediction RMSE versus expanding-mean forecast, incremental fixed-horizon decision payoff with equal weighting of test episodes, leave-one-test-episode-out sensitivity, no statistical significance claim
prefix_check: Truncate labels, decisions, and features, and confirm all earlier predictions are identical
not_a_trading_backtest: Overlapping hypothetical decisions cannot be compounded into a portfolio. Any apparent improvement needs subsequent closed-loop nonoverlapping position/capital/order validation.
historical_exposure: All histories have already been examined; chronological fitting is not a newly unseen test set. This is a diagnostic without hyperparameter search.
